name: timing_across_blocks_c1_c2
title: Timing across blocks: C1 pointing and C2 motion
caption: Every panel uses block on the x-axis. Dots: individual trials; lines: medians; bars: IQR. Open triangles: right-censored intervals, excluded from observed-event medians. Reaction times include all valid responses, independent of accuracy. n labels give observed values per cue/block.

name: timing_across_blocks_frequency
title: Timing across blocks separated by attended frequency
caption: C1 top row; C2 bottom row. Six trials per cue x frequency x block. Lines: observed-event median; bars: IQR; dots: individual trials; open triangles: censored. All valid reaction times are included.

name: restricted_timing_across_blocks
title: Timing across blocks including administrative timeouts
caption: All 12 trials per cue/block contribute. Right-censored waiting times contribute the known 15-second tail to restricted means. Shading: 95% trial-bootstrap intervals, resampling within attended-frequency cells; conditional on this participant and block.

name: behavior_reveal_timing
title: Task behavior: attaining and sustaining control
caption: All blocks pooled except the scalar block comparison. Timeouts are censored. First-green-to-reveal points include revealed trials only.

name: pooled_spectra_c1
title: All four blocks pooled: C1 pointing
caption: 24 equally weighted trials per row. Full 1-second windows updated every 100 ms; native 1 Hz resolution. Average linear power before dB. Same-data fitting alone cannot establish an attention effect.

name: pooled_spectra_c2
title: All four blocks pooled: C2 motion
caption: 24 equally weighted trials per row. Full 1-second windows updated every 100 ms; native 1 Hz resolution. Average linear power before dB. Same-data fitting alone cannot establish an attention effect.

name: cue_locked_dynamics
title: Cue-locked power, online scores and control
caption: All blocks pooled. 100 ms updates, trailing 1-second estimators. Shading: between-trial SEM. Display bins with >=5 trials; counts below. Reveal-aligned growth is partly selected by the stopping rule.

name: reveal_locked_dynamics
title: Reveal-locked power, online scores and control
caption: All blocks pooled. 100 ms updates, trailing 1-second estimators. Shading: between-trial SEM. Display bins with >=5 trials; counts below. Reveal-aligned growth is partly selected by the stopping rule.

name: reveal_locked_frequency_split
title: Reveal dynamics separated by attended frequency
caption: 17/19 Hz balanced within cue and block. Bins require >=5 trials. Successful-reveal selection remains.

name: reveal_locked_attended_distractor
title: Attended and distractor components around reveal
caption: Fixed pre-reveal cohort: 56 trials with reveal latency >=4 s. Shading: between-trial SEM. Post-trigger support decreases with trial stopping. Power uses same-window fits; the separate preceding-window analysis checks fitting sensitivity.

name: block_scalar_robustness
title: Scalar outcomes across blocks
caption: Six trials per point. Spectra remain pooled. Early endpoints 1-2 s after cue precede every reveal. Block differences are descriptive; no learning claim.

name: interval_power_comparison
title: Within-trial interval comparisons
caption: Fixed cohort of 38 revealed trials with latency >=4 s and complete +1 to +2 s post-reveal coverage. Thin lines are individual trials; thick lines are unweighted descriptive cue means. Formal contrasts in the tables balance cells. Pre/post reflect outcome selection and visual/response changes.

name: early_power_vs_reveal_time
title: Early dominance versus time to reveal
caption: 96 trial means; cell centering controls additive session/cue/frequency means. No causal interpretation or confirmatory p-values.

name: fixed_cohort_reveal
title: Reveal dynamics with fixed trial membership
caption: Same 56 trials throughout: revealed at >=4 s. Outcome-dependent selection remains.

name: individual_reveal_heatmaps
title: Individual reveal-locked trials
caption: Revealed C1 then C2 trials, sorted by latency. White=unavailable. Symmetric 95th absolute percentile limits for display only; all observations retained in calculations.

name: attention_frequency_decomposition
title: Instruction effect versus 17/19 Hz asymmetry
caption: 48 trials per assignment. Both curves rising in physical 17-minus-19 coordinates indicates a common frequency asymmetry; opposite shifts would support instruction following. Thin lines: trial observations. Formal balanced contrasts are exported.

name: fit_vs_next_window_peak
title: Do fitted target peaks persist out of the fitting window?
caption: Full cue-to-reveal/timeout intervals; PSD averaged within each trial first. Local prominence uses target / mean(16,18,20 Hz) within its own projection. Target peaks that collapse out of fitting window provide weak evidence of a stable spatial signal.
